meta.name: AI-Powered Business Support Workflow Assistant
meta.tagline: A small AI-powered assistant to streamline support request handling for support staff, ensuring human oversight and control.

guardrails.text: The assistant must not send messages, close or resolve tickets, change ticket priority, change permissions or user access, modify data, delete information, or escalate a case automatically.
guardrails.mechanism: src/guardrail.js (validateAssistantOutput) + src/presentToAgent.js (the sanctioned boundary that calls it before any output reaches an agent)
guardrails.evidence: 17/17 tests passing across tests/guardrail.test.js and tests/presentToAgent.test.js

guardrails.text: The system must keep an audit trail of AI recommendations and human approvals or rejections.
guardrails.mechanism: src/auditLog.js (appendAuditEntry — hash-chained, append-only JSON Lines write path with fail-closed stderr ALERT on failure) + src/auditedActions.js (classifyAndLog/reviewAndLog — the only callers currently wired to persist; calling classify.js/reviewClassification.js directly does not auto-log)
guardrails.evidence: 68/68 tests passing across tests/auditLog.test.js and tests/auditedActions.test.js

requirements.text: Classify support requests into predefined categories.
Determine urgency/priority and produce a short summary.
Search the knowledge base for approved troubleshooting instructions and recommend next steps.
Generate a professional draft response for agent review.
Let a support agent review, approve, edit, or reject classification, solution, and draft response.
Recommend escalation, with reasoning, when the knowledge base can’t resolve an issue.
Produce a final support summary once the workflow completes.
Never act on tickets/data/permissions automatically — recommend only.
Read from a small knowledge base of approved instructions and sample tickets.
Keep an audit trail of AI recommendations and human approvals/rejections.

releases.name: Knowledge Base Integration and Response Drafting

stories.title: Human Approval of Classification and Priority

users.wants: review, approve, edit, or reject what the assistant classifies, recommends, and drafts — never have it act on its own.
a complete, trustworthy trail of every AI recommendation and every human approval or rejection.
